summary: Gamehaus Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its board extended its share repurchase program for an additional year through August 28, 2027, maintaining the original US$5 million authorization. As of the report date, the company had repurchased approximately 518,063 Class A ordinary shares for about US$600,000. Repurchases may occur via open market, negotiated, block trades, or Rule 10b-18 trading plans, funded from existing cash and operations. The board authorized the extension on August 27, 2026. No advisors or premium terms were stated. Watch repurchase pace and remaining authorization capacity.
